title: His first book: IT trends for solution architects
oneliner: His first book covers IT trends for solution architects across 25 chapters, every concept explained with an analogy - for platform, infrastructure, data, and AI solution architects alike.
says: After the response to his second book, people asked about the first one. This reel introduces it: a book on IT trends for solution architects, 25 chapters, each written specifically for solution architects, with every concept explained through an analogy so it is easy to absorb. Aimed at anyone pursuing platform, infrastructure, data, or AI solution architect careers.
explained: The analogy-first approach is the signature he carries into the reels themselves - LangChain as an engine, LangGraph as the GPS. If his analogies on this site work for you, the first book is 25 chapters of the same treatment.

Placed next to the second book, the two volumes split his worldview cleanly: the first is breadth - the trends a solution architect must be conversant in; the second is depth on the AI-agent era specifically. Together they are the reading-version of this entire channel.
takeaway: Announcement: the first book (25 analogy-driven chapters on IT trends for architects) complements the second. Breadth first, AI depth second.
